notes.accuracy: LLM-judge correctness (mymem_judge); category 5 (adversarial) counts abstention as correct
notes.scored_f1: official run F1 (mymem_f1); token F1, except category 5 where it is 1/0 on abstention
notes.lexical: recomputed hypothesis-vs-golden-answer metrics using the same formulas as the lme_ref files
notes.latency_ms: per-question memory-read latency = avg per-user end-to-end fetch (mem_read_lat.avg_e2e_ms); rerank time excluded
notes.latency_backfill: 162 conv-26 questions lacked latency in the v2 run and were backfilled from v2_ans+descrip_top10 by exact question match
notes.context_tokens: tiktoken cl100k_base token count of retrieved_context
